title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR FOREST (PROTECTION) FORCE ACT, 2001
full_text: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR FOREST (PROTECTION) FORCE ACT, 2001 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200106 Act Number: 6 Enactment Date: 2001-04-12 Act Year: 2001 Short Title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR FOREST (PROTECTION) FORCE ACT, 2001 Long Title: An Act to provide for the constitution of Forest Protection Force for better protection and security of the forest property and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of Forest, Ecology and Environment. Enforcement Date: 12-04-2001 Type: STATE Location: Jammu and Kashmir TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Constitution of the Force. Section 4. Appointment of Officers and other ranks of the Force. Section 5. Certificates to Members of the Force. Section 6. Superintendence, control and administration of the Force. Section 7. Dismissal, removal etc. of Members of the Force. Section 8. Appeal and revision. Section 9. Duties of the Members of the Force. Section 10. Power to arrest without warrant and procedure to be followed. Section 11. Powers to search without warrant. Section 12. Members of the Force to be considered always on duty. Section 13. Restrictions respecting right to form associations etc. Section 14. Responsibilities of Members of the Force during suspension. Section 15. Surrender of certificates, Arms etc. by persons ceasing to be Members of the Force. Section 16. Penalties for neglect of duty etc. Section 17. Protection of acts of Members of the Force. Section 18. Power to make rules.
